author: bald and bankrupt
description:
🇹🇲 In the 8 years since I started the bald and bankrupt channel we have visited 14 of the former Soviet Replublics together. Well, it was finally time to complete the series with our 15th and final former Soviet republic. The hardest of all to get to: the bonkersTurkmenistan. Join me, as together we explore the Central Asian nation and take a peek at everyday life there. I might even find a wife...

Check out Joe's Insta @joepenprase and his TikTok @penprase for his vids and photos from the trip

Don't forget to check out my books at www.mrbaldandbankrupt.com
title: I Visited The Strangest Country On Earth
